Corollary
[space-time Ricci flatness modulo inverse dimension] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 3.1.2\group Cao–Zhu Riemannian Formalism in Potentially Infinite Dimensions All components of the Ricci tensor of $\tilde{g}$ are zero $($modulo $N^{-1})$.

Proof

\sketch Contract the curvature components from the preceding proposition; the contracted Li–Yau–Hamilton terms cancel to order $N^{-1}$.

□
